text:
alice: saw a spike in "failed pages" alerts ~5m ago, looks systemic
incidentbot: alert: notify-proxy outgoing pagerwebhook errors (gateway/blank-header) 10 failures / 4m
ben: hmm, any customer pages impacted or just internal test hooks?
alice: both. customer paging path /v1/pagers/send goes via notify-proxy -> fastedge-cache -> notify-ingress. fastedge is returning an X-Oncall header but it's blank.
sara: we rolled fastedge sidecar change ~6m ago. @deploybot who deployed what?
deploybot: deploy: fastedge-sidecar v1.14 deployed at 2024-10-13T02:03:12Z by ci/pipeline #512 (added upstream caching & header normalization)
ben: that lines up. if header is present but empty, incidentbot's mapper treats it as explicit mapping -> no fallback. runbook expects header absent to trigger fallback.
alice: reproduction from staging:
```
curl -s -D - -H 'X-Oncall-Route: team-sre' -X POST https://fastedge-cache/proxy -d '{"alert":"ping"}'
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Via: fastedge-cache
X-Oncall-Route:
```
(note header key on response exists but value length 0)
sara: oy. mitigation options: 1) toggle sidecar header-preserve flag 2) bypass cache for pager traffic 3) rollback sidecar. which is fastest?
ops-oncall: I can kick manual pages while we triage. paging primary now for customer-A and internal-sre. SMS showed delivery to 3/4, one carrier rejected -> account team following up.
ben: can we make incidentbot defensive: treat empty header same as missing and trigger default fallback? short-term hotfix would reduce blast radius.
alice: agree. short plan: a) patch incidentbot header-check to treat empty as missing and redeploy b) flip fastedge header-preserve to true for pager paths c) add metric: header-empty count + alert d) create post-deploy smoke test for headers
sara: I can own the flip. alice can push the incidentbot patch. ben, please update runbook behavioral note. ops-oncall stay on call for 45m.
alice: applying fastedge toggle to bypass pager path now:
```
kubectl -n infra annotate svc fastedge-cache "pager-bypass=true" --overwrite
```
alice: bypass in place, re-run reproducer...
incidentbot: alert: pagerwebhook errors decreasing -> 0 failures in last 1m :white_check_mark:
ops-oncall: manual pages succeeded after bypass. opening support ticket for the bounced customer number (cust-9002) and notifying accounts.
ben: pushing small incidentbot patch that treats empty header as no-value, adding unit test and feature flag. will ship to canary.
sara: infra retro scheduled tomorrow to review sidecar header normalization change. need to add preflight smoke that verifies header passthrough for critical routes.
alice: filing infra ticket with packet captures and diff of sidecar config. tagging @integrations-team to audit any signing/401 noise seen in earlier probes.
ops-oncall: staying on until 2024-10-13T03:00Z to confirm stability.
incidentbot: note: incident created INC-20241013-0123 - attached logs and failed payloads
ben: follow-ups: runbook update, incidentbot defensive change, post-deploy header smoke, customer follow-up for bounced SMS, retro for sidecar rollout. assign owners and close when all done. :thumbsup:
